name: race-mode
title: Race mode for wheeled and tracked locomotion
creator: rosatus
notes: Implemented + verified 2026-09-23. race_mode_test.gd PASS (overlay math, solver swap, tracked >8m/s race vs <2.4 normal, wheeled >15m/s vs <8.5, pivot yaw assist, byte-exact param restore, sy155w overlay validates). Drift update 2026-09-23: Shift/JoyA handbrake on wheeled race path only - rear lateral grip cut + rear brake bite + steer-driven yaw tracker with slip-limit fade; normal solver ignores drift channel; high-speed lateral accel authority raised 2.4x->4.0x. Tests verify drift engages, rotates >1.5x plain steering, holds bounded slip, recovers on release, and is inert in normal mode. Tank-steering update: speed-scaled yaw capacity ((belt-|v|)*2/gauge*0.45, floor 0.7) + inside-belt braking for over-capacity demand + turn grip dip (max 30%) + cornering drag; lateral resistance back to 1.0x, pivot 0.75. Verified: ~0.7 rad/s yaw at 14 m/s vs ~3.2 pivot at standstill, progressive arc, grip dip telemetry, speed bleed. Regression: tracked_contact_regression, wheeled_locomotion, tracked_chassis_locomotion, sy155w_wheeled, assist_menu all PASS. operator_ui_test + jolt_chassis_track_test fail identically on clean HEAD (pre-existing env failures: soil timing, sy205 clearance/reverse). Pending: user acceptance of racing feel; archive after acceptance.
